plain_english: Bow to you who, having manifested the becoming-agitated delusion, breaks it — to knowledge-bliss, nondual — O god, having covered, to uncoverer.
sanskrit_cite: namas te bhavasambhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate

plain_english: By which wishes could her end-distinction be reached — stealing māyā in one wink — may that Śiva protect us.
sanskrit_cite: yasyāḥ prāpyeta paryantaviśeṣaḥ kair manorathaiḥ māyām ekanimeṣeṇa muṣṇaṃs tāṃ pātu naḥ śivaḥ

plain_english: Weighty course of dispassion, supreme glory of knowledge, highest peak of desirelessness — of bearing these, you, O lord, are lord.
sanskrit_cite: vairāgyasya gatiṃ gurvīṃ jñānasya paramāṃ śriyam naiḥspṛhyasya parāṃ koṭiṃ bibhratāṃ tvaṃ prabho prabhuḥ

plain_english: Even of Brahmā you are Brahmā; of whom, O lord of lords, are you not lord — world-welfare's welfare, how great you are — who knows?
sanskrit_cite: brahmaṇo 'pi bhavān brahma kasya neśas tvam īśituḥ jagatkalyāṇakalyāṇaṃ kiyat tvam iti vetti kaḥ

plain_english: What with other kin, what with friends and masters likewise — in every place, my lord, you are who lifts from the becoming-ocean.
sanskrit_cite: kim anyair bandhubhiḥ kiṃ ca suhṛdbhiḥ svāmibhis tathā sarvasthāne mameśa tvaṃ ya uddhartā bhavārṇavāt

plain_english: Victorious drops of divine nectar — drawn by Śaiva-yoga power, able to wash the stain of delusion, māyā, and the rest.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti mohamāyādimalasaṃkṣālanakṣamāḥ śaivayogabalākṛṣṭā divyapīyūṣavipruṣaḥ

plain_english: By Gāyatrī is sung whose thought-impelling radiance — may he impel, I hope, our thoughts on the true path, the lord.
sanskrit_cite: gāyatryā gīyate yasya dhiyāṃ tejaḥ pracodakam codayed api kaccin naḥ sa dhiyaḥ satpathe prabhuḥ

plain_english: O eight-formed, in even one form will you not make eternal standing for us — or pleased, will you do all?
sanskrit_cite: aṣṭamūrte kim ekasyām api mūrtau na naḥ sthitim śāśvatīṃ kuruṣe yad vā tuṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ kariṣyasi

plain_english: Reality-principle of categories generally effects purpose — but yours, O lord, even the name gives accomplishment up to liberation.
sanskrit_cite: vastutattvaṃ padārthānāṃ prāyeṇārthakriyākaram bhavatas tv īśa nāmāpi mokṣaparyantasiddhidam

plain_english: Again and again, to arrange each next state of the world-picture — by that power of yours, O lord, what mindful one is not amazed?
sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur jagaccitrasy-ānyānyāṃ sthitim ūhitum śaktir yā te tayā nātha ko manasvī na vismitaḥ

plain_english: To make hard easy, to gladden suffering likewise — sole-heroic is whose remembrance: him we remember, love's foe.
sanskrit_cite: duṣkaraṃ sukarīkartuṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhayituṃ tathā ekavīrā smṛtir yasya taṃ smarāmaḥ smaradviṣam

plain_english: Victorious are songs whose singable is the supreme lord — by whose name even great souls are sown with thrill-sprouts.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti gītayo yāsāṃ sa geyaḥ parameśvaraḥ yannāmnāpi mahātmānaḥ kīryante pulakāṅkuraiḥ

plain_english: As you, indeed you would be, if supreme — O Bhava, whose three-world beginning and dissolution is arrayed by own power formations.
sanskrit_cite: bhavān iva bhavān eva bhaved yadi paraṃ bhava svaśaktivyūhasaṃvyūḍhatrailokyārambhasaṃhṛtiḥ

plain_english: Mantra you are, counsel-worthy you are, counsellor — whence another than you? He — to me give that mantra, so that I may be your mantra, O lord.
sanskrit_cite: mantro 'si mantraṇīyo 'si mantrī tvattaḥ kuto 'paraḥ sa mahyaṃ dehi taṃ mantraṃ tvanmantraḥ syāṃ yathā prabho

plain_english: Light-formed, true-resolve, you are the self of whom — even he am I — 'transmigrator' thus — what, O lord, is this — that dream even, whence in you?
sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaḥ satyasaṃkalpas tvam ātmā yasya so 'py aham saṃsārīti kim īśaiṣa svapnaḥ so 'pi kutas tvayi

plain_english: That unbroken, that unvulgar, that one, coherent — in you, O lord, is the lordship of those who entrust work-fruits.
sanskrit_cite: tad abhaṅgi tad agrāmyaṃ tad ekam upapattimat tvayi karmaphalanyāsakṛtām aiśvaryam īśa yat

plain_english: Capable — what misfortune not to destroy, what fortune not to give, or — who is that one: he is our beloved, god of gods, bull-bannered.
sanskrit_cite: kṣamaḥ kāṃ nāpadaṃ hantuṃ kāṃ dātuṃ sampadaṃ na vā yo 'sau sa dayito 'smākaṃ devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ

plain_english: For the divine knowledge-eye blinded by māyā-made stain — in purifying, O lord, devotion to you is the supreme ointment.
sanskrit_cite: māyāmayamalāndhasya divyasya jñānacakṣuṣaḥ nirmalīkaraṇe nātha tvadbhaktiḥ paramāñjanam

plain_english: Fearless, bliss-constituted, one, imperishable — give the state, come to me, O god — quickly — why wait for that?
sanskrit_cite: nirbhayaṃ yad yad ānandamayam ekaṃ yad avyayam padaṃ dehy ehi me deva tūrṇaṃ tat kiṃ pratīkṣase

plain_english: Ah, naturally deep, dreadful is the transmigration-ocean; ah, the means to cross it — the supreme someone — great lord.
sanskrit_cite: aho nisargagambhīro ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ aho tattaraṇopāyaḥ paraḥ ko 'pi maheśvaraḥ
